announcement.quote: a very important matter affecting your investment in Tortoise Midstream Energy Fund, Inc. (the “Target Fund”) and/or Tortoise Energy Infrastructure Corporation (the “Acquiring Fund” and, together with the Target Fund, the “Funds” or each, individually, a “Fund”), each a Maryland corporation.

deals.notes: No filing excerpt states how this merger ended (the 2024-11-13 and 2024-11-25 8-Ks, the 425 and the later filings are shown only by their first 800 characters, with no outcome text). The 2024-08-07 DEFA14As (seq=1, 2) refer to proposed mergers of six Tortoise/Ecofin funds and a new ETF, but the excerpt does not say which funds merge into which.

target.name: Tortoise Sustainable & Social Impact Term Fund

deals.notes: Recorded from the cover pages of DEFA14A seq=15 (0001140361-25-026212, filed 2025-07-17), which name Tortoise Energy Infrastructure Corporation and Tortoise Sustainable and Social Impact Term Fund as registrants, and the 2025-06-20 N-14 (seq=11), whose excerpt refers to a 'Target Fund' with a termination date and an 'Eligible Tender Offer' without naming it. The excerpts do not say the merger, its terms or its outcome in words.

problems: Excerpts are compact: no outcome language in any filing; the 2024 and 2025 proposals are named only by cover pages or party lists. Other funds named in the 2024-08-07 DEFA14As (Tortoise Power and Energy Infrastructure Fund, Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Tortoise Energy Independence Fund) are not stated as targets of this acquirer, so not recorded as deals.
